metrics.name: googleAds.clicks
metrics.label: Clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on your ads during the reporting period.

metrics.name: googleAds.impressions
metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your ads were shown, including repeat views by the same person.

metrics.name: googleAds.spend
metrics.label: Cost
metrics.description: Total amount spent on your ads during the reporting period, in your account currency.

metrics.name: googleAds.ctr
metrics.label: CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate: clicks divided by impressions, shown as a percentage.

metrics.name: googleAds.cpm
metrics.label: CPM
metrics.description: Average cost per 1,000 impressions: spend divided by impressions (×1,000), in account currency.

metrics.name: googleAds.cpc
metrics.label: CPC
metrics.description: Average cost per click: spend divided by clicks, in account currency.

metrics.name: googleAds.costPerConversion
metrics.label: Cost per conversion (CPA)
metrics.description: Average spend for each conversion: spend divided by the number of conversion events.

metrics.name: googleAds.conversionValue
metrics.label: Conversion value
metrics.description: Total value attributed to conversion events (e.g. revenue from purchases) during the reporting period.

metrics.name: googleAds.roas
metrics.label: ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend for attributed revenue or value divided by spend.

metrics.name: googleAds.viewThroughConversions
metrics.label: View-through conversions
metrics.description: Conversions recorded when a user saw (but did not click) your ad and later converted.

metrics.name: googleAds.conversions
metrics.label: Conversions
metrics.description: Number of completed conversion actions you are measuring (e.g. purchases, sign-ups, leads).

metrics.name: googleAds.conversionRate
metrics.label: Conversion rate
metrics.description: Percentage of clicks that resulted in a conversion: conversions ÷ clicks.

dimensions.name: googleAds.date
dimensions.label: Date
dimensions.description: Date when the ad metrics were recorded.

dimensions.name: googleAds.adNetworkType
dimensions.label: Ad network
dimensions.description: Ad network where your ads were shown (e.g. Google Search, Display Network, YouTube).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignId
dimensions.label: Campaign ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the campaign.

dimensions.name: googleAds.device
dimensions.label: Device
dimensions.description: Device type on which the ad was shown (mobile, desktop, tablet).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignName
dimensions.label: Campaign
dimensions.description: Name of the ad campaign.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignStatus
dimensions.label: Campaign status
dimensions.description: Current delivery status of the campaign (enabled, paused, or removed).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignServingStatus
dimensions.label: Campaign serving status
dimensions.description: Serving status of the campaign indicating why it may not be delivering (e.g. ended, pending, serving).

dimensions.name: googleAds.advertisingChannelType
dimensions.label: Campaign type
dimensions.description: Campaign type that determines where ads can appear (e.g. Search, Display, Shopping, Video).

dimensions.name: googleAds.advertisingChannelSubType
dimensions.label: Campaign sub-type
dimensions.description: Sub-type of the campaign (e.g. Search Standard, Shopping Smart).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetId
dimensions.label: Campaign budget ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the campaign budget in Google Ads.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetName
dimensions.label: Campaign budget name
dimensions.description: Name of the budget shared across campaigns.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetAmountMicros
dimensions.label: Campaign daily budget
dimensions.description: Daily budget for the campaign, in the account's currency.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetTotalAmountMicros
dimensions.label: Campaign total budget
dimensions.description: Total lifetime budget for the campaign, in the account's currency.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetType
dimensions.label: Campaign budget type
dimensions.description: The type of budget strategy used for the campaign (e.g., daily, shared).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetPeriod
dimensions.label: Campaign budget period
dimensions.description: Time period the campaign budget covers (e.g. daily, monthly).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignBudgetExplicitlyShared
dimensions.label: Shared budget
dimensions.description: Whether the budget is explicitly shared across multiple campaigns.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignCriterionId
dimensions.label: Campaign criterion ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the campaign-level targeting criterion in Google Ads.

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignCriterionType
dimensions.label: Campaign criterion type
dimensions.description: Type of targeting criterion applied at the campaign level (e.g. location, keyword).

dimensions.name: googleAds.campaignCriterionNegative
dimensions.label: Negative criterion
dimensions.description: Whether the criterion is excluded (negative targeting) at the campaign level.

dimensions.name: googleAds.biddingStrategyId

dimensions.name: googleAds.biddingStrategyName
dimensions.label: Bidding strategy name
dimensions.description: Name of the bidding strategy applied to this campaign.

dimensions.name: googleAds.biddingStrategyType
dimensions.label: Bidding strategy type
dimensions.description: Type of bid strategy used (e.g. Target CPA, Maximize Conversions, Manual CPC).

dimensions.name: googleAds.adGroupType

dimensions.name: googleAds.searchTermStatus

dimensions.name: googleAds.adGroupAssetStatus

dimensions.name: googleAds.assetName
